description: Shape of place_order response — the outcome of a single order submission, echoes input plus server-assigned ID / status / strategy.

fields.description: Result status — see describe(topic='resultStatus'). 'ok' = accepted, 'rejected' = pre-trade rejection, 'blocked' = gate (e.g. locked-in), 'failed' = system error.
Server-assigned order ID on success; absent on rejection.
Strategy ID when brackets were requested; absent otherwise.
Machine-friendly rejection code. Present only when status ≠ 'ok'.
Echo of input.brackets on bracket orders; the legs that will spawn on entry fill.
